adultGuide.title: Paper Tab Story Inference Adult Guide, adult-led fictional offline paper-only family-friendly: ____________________.
setupSteps: Place one paper tab card, blank paper, pencil, and scrap tab at the adult-led fictional offline paper-only table: ____________________.
Name the clue, what it might suggest, why, second clue, inference sentence, and paper tab check blanks before writing: ____________________.
Choose one made-up story moment and keep each clue adult-led, fictional, offline, paper-only, and family-friendly: ____________________.
Let the writer point, dictate, or write short paper phrases while the adult keeps the inference calm: ____________________.
Close by reading the inference sentence and paper tab check from the paper card only: ____________________.
facilitationNotes: Ask for one tiny clue first so the adult-led fictional offline paper-only inference has a clear start: ____________________.
Use might suggest language before asking for why, so the writer can try an idea without pressure: ____________________.
Ask why the clue might suggest the idea, and accept a short family-friendly fictional phrase: ____________________.
Add a second clue only after the first clue and why line feel clear on paper: ____________________.
Finish with the paper tab check as a quiet adult-led paper-only mark for the inference sentence: ____________________.
safetyNotes: Keep all names, places, events, clues, and paper tabs made-up for this adult-led fictional offline paper-only activity: ____________________.
Skip any line that asks for personal facts, exact places, outside facts, or child details: ____________________.
Use the tabs only as pretend paper markers for this family-friendly inference card: ____________________.
Keep the inference sentence about the invented story, not about a person outside the card: ____________________.
Treat the paper tab check as a calm ending to one adult-led fictional offline paper-only session: ____________________.

inferenceRoutines.title: Clue Spot Routine, adult-led fictional offline paper-only family-friendly: ____________________.
inferenceRoutines.useWhen: Use when the writer needs one invented clue before deciding what it might suggest: ____________________.
steps: The adult places the blank clue line beside the paper tab card: ____________________.
The writer names one fictional clue from the made-up story moment: ____________________.
The adult asks what the clue might suggest inside the pretend story: ____________________.
The writer fills this paper-only line: This clue might suggest ____________________.

inferenceRoutines.title: Might Suggest Bridge Routine, adult-led fictional offline paper-only family-friendly: ____________________.
inferenceRoutines.useWhen: Use when the clue is chosen but the idea it might suggest is still loose: ____________________.
steps: The adult reads the clue slowly from the paper card: ____________________.
The writer says one idea the clue might suggest in the fictional story: ____________________.
The adult repeats the idea with gentle why language: ____________________.
The writer completes this adult-led line: The clue might suggest ____________________ because ____________________.

inferenceRoutines.title: Why Line Routine, adult-led fictional offline paper-only family-friendly: ____________________.
inferenceRoutines.useWhen: Use when the writer has a clue and a might suggest idea but needs a why line: ____________________.
steps: The adult points to the why blank and keeps the card offline and paper-only: ____________________.
The writer explains why the clue might suggest the story idea: ____________________.
The adult helps trim the why line to one fictional phrase: ____________________.
The writer writes this line: My why is ____________________.

inferenceRoutines.title: Second Clue Routine, adult-led fictional offline paper-only family-friendly: ____________________.
inferenceRoutines.useWhen: Use when one clue and why line are ready and the inference needs a second clue: ____________________.
steps: The adult rereads the first clue and why line from the paper: ____________________.
The writer chooses a second clue that fits the same made-up idea: ____________________.
The adult asks how the second clue might suggest the same inference: ____________________.
The writer fills this line: My second clue is ____________________.

inferenceRoutines.title: Inference Sentence Routine, adult-led fictional offline paper-only family-friendly: ____________________.
inferenceRoutines.useWhen: Use when the clue, might suggest idea, why, and second clue are ready to combine: ____________________.
steps: The adult reads the clue, might suggest idea, why, and second clue in order: ____________________.
The writer chooses the words that belong in one inference sentence: ____________________.
The adult keeps the sentence fictional, offline, paper-only, and family-friendly: ____________________.
The writer completes this line: My inference sentence is ____________________.

inferenceRoutines.title: Paper Tab Check Routine, adult-led fictional offline paper-only family-friendly: ____________________.
inferenceRoutines.useWhen: Use when the inference sentence is written and needs a final paper tab check: ____________________.
steps: The adult places the paper tab beside the inference sentence: ____________________.
The writer points to the clue and second clue that support the sentence: ____________________.
The adult asks why the paper tab check shows a clear fictional inference: ____________________.
The writer completes this line: My paper tab check says ____________________.

takeHomeInferenceSlips.title: Tiny Clue Slip, adult-led fictional offline paper-only family-friendly: ____________________.
takeHomeInferenceSlips.adultNote: Use this slip as an adult-led paper-only way to start one made-up inference: ____________________.

takeHomeInferenceSlips.title: Might Suggest Slip, adult-led fictional offline paper-only family-friendly: ____________________.
takeHomeInferenceSlips.adultNote: Ask for a pretend idea first, then ask why the clue might suggest it: ____________________.

takeHomeInferenceSlips.title: Why Slip, adult-led fictional offline paper-only family-friendly: ____________________.
takeHomeInferenceSlips.adultNote: Keep the why line short, fictional, offline, paper-only, and family-friendly: ____________________.

takeHomeInferenceSlips.title: Second Clue Slip, adult-led fictional offline paper-only family-friendly: ____________________.
takeHomeInferenceSlips.prompt: My second clue is ____________________, and it might suggest ____________________.
takeHomeInferenceSlips.adultNote: Choose a second clue that supports the same invented inference sentence: ____________________.

takeHomeInferenceSlips.title: Inference Sentence Slip, adult-led fictional offline paper-only family-friendly: ____________________.
takeHomeInferenceSlips.adultNote: Combine the clue, what it might suggest, why, and second clue in one paper sentence: ____________________.

takeHomeInferenceSlips.title: Paper Tab Check Slip, adult-led fictional offline paper-only family-friendly: ____________________.
takeHomeInferenceSlips.prompt: My paper tab check says the clue and second clue fit because ____________________.
takeHomeInferenceSlips.adultNote: Use the paper tab check as a calm ending mark, not a pressure mark: ____________________.

takeHomeInferenceSlips.title: Two Clue Pair Slip, adult-led fictional offline paper-only family-friendly: ____________________.
takeHomeInferenceSlips.prompt: The first clue is ____________________; the second clue is ____________________; together they might suggest ____________________.
takeHomeInferenceSlips.adultNote: Read both fictional clues before asking why they fit together: ____________________.

takeHomeInferenceSlips.title: Character Guess Slip, adult-led fictional offline paper-only family-friendly: ____________________.
takeHomeInferenceSlips.prompt: A made-up character might be thinking ____________________ because the clue is ____________________.
takeHomeInferenceSlips.adultNote: Keep the guess inside the invented story and on paper only: ____________________.

takeHomeInferenceSlips.title: Place Guess Slip, adult-led fictional offline paper-only family-friendly: ____________________.
takeHomeInferenceSlips.prompt: The made-up place might feel ____________________ because the clue is ____________________.
takeHomeInferenceSlips.adultNote: Keep place details broad, invented, offline, paper-only, and family-friendly: ____________________.

takeHomeInferenceSlips.title: Later Paper Tab Slip, adult-led fictional offline paper-only family-friendly: ____________________.
takeHomeInferenceSlips.prompt: Next adult-led paper tab check, I can add a new clue: ____________________.
takeHomeInferenceSlips.adultNote: Save the slip for another fictional offline paper-only inference moment: ____________________.
